items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So I met the fella that -- he came in to (unintelligible) see me at Marco's Pub last evening -- Lee Gruber, went down to his place in Philadelphia, Joe said all right, I'll book you for two weeks. And, Mundell and I and a bass player went down.

ctx.x: We worked around New York a little bit then I finally decided, looking over the situation in California that the only way I could stay in California was to have a trio. So I talked to Mundell about it and he said, 'Well, I don't know.' I talked with Glazer, he said, 'Oh no, no. No, no. Can't do that.'
